references.role: Approved gritty, smooth white limestone surface

generation_prompt: Generate one production-intent seamless repeating limestone masonry wall color texture. Use case: photorealistic-natural. Image 1 is a brick-layout and roughly cut stone-shape reference ONLY; ignore its gray color, triangulated plastic-looking surface, screenshot border and red UI circle. Image 2 is the approved surface/material reference: use its white limestone color, very fine gritty mineral grain, tiny pores and broad smooth worn areas on every brick. Create a NEW wall texture, not a screenshot edit. Perfectly orthographic, straight-on flat wall view filling a single square image, no perspective and no scene or 3D cube. Course layout: EXACTLY SIX brick pitches across and TEN horizontal courses down, staggered running bond with a half-brick offset on alternating courses. Each brick has a square footprint/top profile about nine inches wide and nine inches deep; its visible wall face is a flattened rectangle about nine inches wide and five-and-a-half inches tall. Only front faces are seen. Stones are roughly cut rectangular prisms with gently irregular chipped bevels and subtle face variation, preserving a convincing cut-stone brick look. These are orderly masonry units, not perfect cubes, not rubble, not squarish inflated cobbles. Dense fine gritty white limestone on broadly smooth faces, very restrained ivory/off-white variation between stones. Thin recessed pale warm-gray lime mortar joints, about 3 millimetres; dark enough to separate the bricks gently, not black outlines. No large cracks, sedimentary stripe pattern, chunky grit, sharp triangular facets or glossy plastic finish. Flat neutral diffuse illumination suitable for a wall color texture: no directional sunlight, no lighting gradient, no cast shadow across the image, no vignette, no frame. CRITICAL SEAMLESSNESS: this exact square image must repeat in both horizontal and vertical directions. Make ten courses an even repeating cycle. Crop top and bottom through the matching centres of the same horizontal mortar seam. Even rows crop left/right through matching joint centres; odd offset rows must wrap one brick across the left/right image edges with exactly matching stone shape, height, color and granular surface continuity. Opposite borders must join continuously with no double mortar stripe, broken course, truncated mismatching stone or brightness seam. Do not draw a grid of texture samples or a montage; output only ONE continuous seamless tile. No text, measurement labels, watermark, UI, borders, characters or props.
repeat_correction_prompt: Edit this limestone brick wall texture ONLY to make its masonry layout rigorously seamless. Keep the same white gritty yet smooth limestone material, pale mortar, subtle chipped edges, and photographic detail. Correct its spacing and border cropping. The current image has approximately FIVE bricks across and TEN rows, and the bottom row is cut off incorrectly. Final layout must be precisely FIVE brick pitches across and TEN COMPLETE courses vertically in one square texture tile. The front of a brick is a horizontally flattened rectangle about twice as wide as it is tall: nine inches wide and four-and-a-half inches tall, with an implied nine-inch depth so its top footprint is square. Alternate running-bond rows are shifted by half a brick. Slightly adjust course spacing to fit all ten full courses in the image. CRITICAL: TOP AND BOTTOM EDGES BOTH LIE AT THE CENTER OF A MATCHING THIN HORIZONTAL MORTAR JOINT. No stone face may touch the top or bottom border; both must finish in matching narrow mortar half-joints so stacking tiles makes an ordinary single-width joint. Left and right borders wrap correctly: alternate rows have matching mortar half-joints at both sides; the other rows have two matching halves of ONE stone, continuous across the horizontal tile boundary. All row heights and all vertical joint offsets match perfectly across the left/right boundary. No brightness or grain discontinuities on wrapping stones. Use uniform flat diffuse illumination and consistent neutral limestone white color. This is the final square wall texture for both horizontal and vertical repeat. No borders, text, ruler, seam lines, UI, perspective or extra objects. Preserve surface appearance; adjust only layout/spacing and edge continuity. Output only one texture tile.
technical_finish: Blender emission bake through mortar-joint centres, narrow border harmonization, exact outermost-texel closure, decoded PNG verification and 3x3 visual review.
scope: One repeating wall color texture only; no PBR map set, scene edit, Unity import or wall geometry.
